products.consoleNote: patterned from the 2022-2025 consoles; not seen on SportsCardsPro — verify before the first mark (data/classes/README: never pattern); Cardsmiths names the set 'Prospect Autograph' (CPA-, 86); May and Sep may share one console as in 2025/2026

products.name: 2021 Bowman Draft
products.consoleNote: patterned from the 2022-2025 consoles; not seen on SportsCardsPro — verify before the first mark (data/classes/README: never pattern); Cardsmiths 'Chrome Draft Pick Autographs' (CDA-, 84); Draft autos are CDA- through 2023 (03 §1G)

note: Derivation (08-classes.md §3f): every hobby Chrome prospect autograph of 2021 Bowman (Chrome Prospect Autograph, CPA-, 72; release Apr 27 2021), 2021 Bowman Chrome (Prospect Autograph, CPA-, 86; release Sep 21 2021) and 2021 Bowman Draft (Chrome Draft Pick Autographs, CDA-, 84; release Dec 30 2021) from Cardsmiths full checklists, read Oct 29 2026, matched by accent-folded player name (suffixes dropped) against 2018 Bowman Chrome CPA (80), 2019 Bowman / Chrome / Draft (62 / 68 / 81) and 2020 Bowman / Chrome / Draft (62 / 75 / 118) Chrome prospect auto lists, and the earlier 2021 releases. Result: 242 rows, 229 true, 12 false (Hendrick, Lacy, Hancock, Ed Howard, G. Mitchell, Kjerstad, Meyer, N. Gonzales, P. Bailey, Hassell, Torkelson, Veen — 2020 Bowman Draft CDAs), 1 held (Cristian Santana, DET 2021 Chrome vs LAD 2019 Bowman — 08 §1 hold rule). No code repeats inside a 2021 product. Not counted as priors (08 §1 / G61 working rule): 2021 Bowman Paper Prospect Autograph PAPR- (31; 24 signers without a 2021 CPA, e.g. Julio Rodriguez, whose Chrome auto is 2019 Bowman Chrome), Dual / Scouts Top 100 / Positional Promise / Dawn of Glory / 40 Man Futures / Ascensions / Invicta / Genesis / image-variation / Class of 2021 insert autos. 2021 Bowman Sapphire Edition and 2021 Bowman Chrome / Draft Sapphire Edition pages on Cardsmiths list base only (no autos). Open before universeComplete: (1) 2021 Bowman Mega Box and Chrome Mega Box prospect auto sets (Cardsmiths 404); (2) 2018 Bowman and 2018 Bowman Draft auto lists (Cardsmiths 404) — priors before 2019 read for 2018 Chrome only; (3) the held row; (4) G49 logo-error names Hearn, Deveaux, Peguero follow the checklist-history test pending Mo; (5) consoles patterned, not seen.
